premises.text: Matching ingredients to skin type and using machine learning to find best-fit products can solve skincare selection
premises.evidence_span: if we can find a way to potentially match ingredients with someone's skin type, and then use machine learning to find out what products best fit, we can probably solve this problem

premises.text: Personal skincare consultant accessible anytime powered by human expertise combined with AI
premises.evidence_span: It is your personal skin care consultant that you can access anytime and is powered by a combination of human expertise and artificial intelligence

premises.text: Intake questions, photo, and dermatologist-like quiz categorize preferences and skin profile across 30+ types and five dimensions
premises.evidence_span: the system first asks you a couple of questions, such as your skin product, products you're interested in, your skin profile, your age, as well as getting a photo of you

premises.text: Recommendations combine skin profile, similar users' likes, and age, then a human advisor cross-checks to one product
premises.evidence_span: I will get my personal recommendation set based on A, my skin profile, B, people who are similar to me and what they have liked, and C, my age. And then it sends all these skin data to a real human advisor who will do a cross-check, validate the system, and then narrow it down to one product and send it to me

premises.text: Customers finish purchase via personal checkout link with Apple Pay, PayPal, or credit card
premises.evidence_span: I get a personal checkout link, which I can use Apple Pay, PayPal, or any credit card to finish checkout process

value.text: Better skin and confidence without trials and errors
value.evidence_span: help more people achieve better skin and gain that confidence without going through all the trials and errors

secondary_value.text: Spend more time looking great and less time wondering how
secondary_value.evidence_span: spend more time looking great and less time wondering how

notes: Transcript opens mid-sentence. Skin-type taxonomy and quiz treated as one profiling mechanism (§4.1.2). Traction metrics excluded. Singleton D2: checkout path separately revisable.
